invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which should not be null under normal circumstances.
records is passed directly to the executor and used in the write operation, so it should not be null here.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should contain a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
getWriteStatuses() must return a concrete List as per the declared generic return type.
context is provided to the commit action executor and required for execution.
